  FROM caption_bundles
  WHERE review_minutes <= 10
  UNION ALL
  SELECT a.bundle_code, b.bundle_code, a.review_minutes + b.review_minutes, a.ready_cues + b.ready_cues
  FROM caption_bundles AS a
  JOIN caption_bundles AS b ON a.bundle_code COLLATE BINARY < b.bundle_code AND a.reel_code <> b.reel_code
  WHERE a.review_minutes + b.review_minutes <= 10
), winner AS (
  SELECT first_code, second_code FROM candidates
  ORDER BY cues DESC, minutes ASC, first_code COLLATE BINARY ASC, second_code COLLATE BINARY ASC
  LIMIT 1

SELECT b.bundle_code, b.review_minutes, b.ready_cues
FROM caption_bundles AS b JOIN winner AS w ON b.bundle_code COLLATE BINARY IN (w.first_code, w.second_code)
ORDER BY b.bundle_code COLLATE BINARY ASC
